parts.text: This question is about nitrogen and compounds of nitrogen.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Nitrogen molecules have the formula N 2 . Some properties of nitrogen are shown: ● melting point of –210 ° C ● boiling point of –196 ° C ● non-conductor of electricity when solid ● insoluble in water.

ms.label: 3(a)(ii)
ms.text: weak force(s) of attraction between molecules

ms.label: 3(a)(iii)
ms.text:
no ions
OR no mobile electrons

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Ammonia is made in the laboratory by heating ammonium chloride with calcium hydroxide. Balance the chemical equation for the reaction. .....NH 4 C l + Ca(OH) 2 → .....NH 3 + CaC l 2 + .....H 2 O [1]

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Hydrazine, N 2 H 4 , is another compound that contains nitrogen and hydrogen. Complete the dot-and-cross diagram to show the electron arrangement in a molecule of hydrazine. Show outer electrons only. [2]

ms.label: 3(d)
ms.text:
all 4 NH dot and cross bonds (1)
single bonding pair between N’s and two non-bonding electrons on each N and no non-bonding e on H and nitrogen octet
complete (1)

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Ammonia and hydrazine are weak bases. The chemical equation for the reaction between one molecule of ammonia and one molecule of water is shown. NH 3 + H 2 O NH 4 + + OH –
